name: a calendar change claim is never NOT_FOUND, even under whole, fresh, followed views; a created claim still is
notes: §6.1 v1.11: a calendar.updated or calendar.deleted claim counts no gcal.event entry towards full coverage: every entry overlapping its window is capped, coverage.change_unprovable. Calendar is read as snapshots, so a change made between two looks and then moved, changed again or removed leaves nothing to compare. A change row a view saw still verifies (verified comes before partial_coverage, §6.2). A calendar.created claim keeps NOT_FOUND, with the meaning §6.1 states: in whole, fresh views of its window (synced at or after end(p,t) + graceMin, every calendar, each bound account), no matching event Attest had not already seen before the claim was on the calendar.

Story (the Calendar simulator's CAL-SIM-1, probe 1). acct-a is bound and every calendar is shown. Attest follows two weeks, each first looked at 08:00 and compared since: week [10-04 00:00, 10-11 00:00] and week [10-11 00:00, 10-18 00:00], each with changesSince 08:00 and last synced 09:50 (the passes of 08:10, 09:05, 09:15, 09:40 and 09:50 merged: one window, one changesSince). At 09:00 muse moves 'Board prep' from Fri 10-09 10:00 to Tue 10-13 10:00 and says so. The two weeks are compared range by range, so the move reaches the ledger as a calendar.created row in the second week (o1, 10-13 10:00, first seen 09:05) and a calendar.deleted row in the first (o2, 10-09 10:00, first seen 09:05). No calendar.updated row exists.

c1 (muse, calendar.updated, 'Board prep', claimed 09:00, minute, targetAt 10-13 10:00): window targetAt ± calendarDays 3 = [10-10 10:00, 10-16 10:00]. Its candidates are calendar.updated rows in the window: none (o1 is calendar.created, o2 calendar.deleted) → match.none, score null.

c1 coverage: both weeks overlap the window and together contain it, both fresh (09:50 ≥ end(09:01) + graceMin 30 = 09:31), both followed from 08:00 ≤ the old change span start 08:58, every calendar, the bound account. v1.10 counted them uncapped → full → not_found, FINAL: a false NOT_FOUND for a move that really happened. v1.11 caps both (coverage.change_unprovable) → partial.

c1 rules: no_target no; underspecified no (subjectOverlap applies); no_coverage no (partial); verified, partial no (no candidate); pending no (graceElapsed: an entry synced 09:50 ≥ 09:31); partial_coverage: partial and bestScoreLt partial → UNVERIFIABLE. PENDING (§8): partial_coverage finalises at end + finalizeUnverifiableHours = 10-07 09:01 > evaluatedAt 10:00. Reasons: coverage.partial {gcal.event}, coverage.change_unprovable {gcal.event}, match.none.

c2 (muse, calendar.created, 'Q3 review', claimed 09:00, targetAt Wed 10-07 14:00): window [10-04 14:00, 10-10 14:00] ⊆ the first week, which is fresh (09:50 ≥ 09:31), shows every calendar and is the bound account's → full (the second week does not overlap it). Candidates: calendar.created rows in the window: none (o1 is at 10-13) → match.none. graceElapsed → not_found → NOT_FOUND, FINAL; the grant binds gcal.event → no coverage.account_unbound. Reasons: match.none.
Orphans: o1 and o2 are changes a followed view saw (changesSince 08:00 < 09:05 ≤ 09:50; no entry began comparing at 09:05), assigned to no claim. No activity → no attribution → no receipt.
